questions.q: Which four benefits does the summary say solitude provides?
a: Clarity, creativity, emotional balance and moral courage
Focus, stamina, charisma and good luck
Patience, humility, vision and charm
Energy, discipline, honesty and speed
questions.why: Lesson 1 lists these as the aspects leaders gain through solitude.

questions.q: What does the summary mean by clarity?
a: Stepping away from outside input to recharge and see freshly
Writing a precise plan for every single task
Saying exactly what you mean at all times
Keeping your calendar completely open
questions.why: Lesson 1 says switching off outside noise restores perspective.

questions.q: Why is FOMO dangerous for a leader?
a: Constant checking pulls attention from work and lowers quality
It makes leaders too confident in their own ideas
It causes teams to work much more slowly
It prevents employees from taking vacations
questions.why: Lesson 2 says focusing fully on your craft beats multitasking.

questions.q: What does the summary say about multitasking?
a: It distracts you and produces a worse result
It is the key skill of modern leaders
It works well for simple tasks only
It saves time when done every day
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the author insists on total focus on the craft.

questions.q: What practices does the summary recommend for quieting inner chatter?
a: Meditation, breathwork and unstructured reflection
Reading news and checking messages often
Delegating all decisions to other people
Exercising until you feel completely exhausted
questions.why: Lesson 3 says leaders must sometimes let go of themselves, not just outside distractions.
